title: Career Roadmap · Turner
summary: A Turner operates conventional or computer-controlled lathes to produce precision cylindrical components, shafts, bushings, threads and other machine parts according to engineering drawings and dimensional tolerances.

facts.Course: Fitter / Turner / Machinist / Tool & Die Maker

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 10 → ITI Turner → Apprenticeship / practical experience → Turner / Lathe Operator → CNC Machinist / Senior Technician.

blocks.label: Entry route
blocks.text: Class 10 is a common starting point for ITI Turner; confirm current trade-specific admission rules.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Science, geometry and technical drawing.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Lathe machines, cutting tools, material properties and precision measurement.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Spatial reasoning, accuracy, concentration, tool handling and workshop safety.

blocks.label: Admissions
blocks.text: Check current DGT and state ITI notifications.

items.text: ITI Turner → Conventional lathe operation, turning, facing, threading and component finishing.
ITI Machinist → Broader machining and precision manufacturing skills.
ITI Fitter → Mechanical fitting and assembly, useful for related workshop roles.
CNC machining training → Computer-controlled turning and production methods.
Diploma in Mechanical / Manufacturing Engineering → Further technical study and advanced manufacturing pathways.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Lathe fundamentals, workshop safety, measuring instruments, cutting tools and engineering drawings.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Turning, facing, taper turning, threading, boring, component finishing and dimensional inspection.

blocks.label: Apprenticeship
blocks.text: Practise machine setup, tool selection, production measurement and quality checks under supervision.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Precision shaft; threaded component; stepped cylindrical part; dimensional inspection report.
DGT’s Turner CTS is a two-year programme. Its curriculum includes practical trade training and on-the-job training or a group project where industry training is unavailable.

blocks.text: Railways, defence production units, public-sector manufacturing and government workshops when vacancies are advertised.

blocks.text: Automotive suppliers, machine shops, precision engineering firms, tool rooms and industrial component manufacturers.

blocks.label: Ideal experience areas
blocks.text: Lathe operation, production machining, tool selection, quality inspection and machine maintenance.

An Indian ITI certificate does not automatically transfer to an overseas trade qualification. Verify current admissions and recognition.
